arabic_html:
خُذِ ٱلْعَفْوَ وَأْمُرْ بِٱلْعُرْفِ
وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ ۞
translation: Take what is given freely, enjoin what is good, and turn away from the ignorant.
exp_h: A whole code in one line
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: Allah commanded His Messenger to pardon people's behaviour rather than hold them to account for it. Accept what comes easily; leave the ignorant alone.
explanation_vo: Ibn Kathīr: Allah commanded His Messenger to pardon people's behaviour rather than hold them to account for it. Accept what comes easily; leave the ignorant alone.
